# The clock domain

The clock a session's frames are drawn at: who moves it, how fast, and when it is held. The one seam a run is made repeatable through — a sketch reads only whether its clock is the wall's, and never which client drives it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Namespace in the definition | sigil.protocol.clock |
| What a host implements | `sigil::protocol::clock::ClockAgent`, mounted by `sigil::protocol::clock::wire` |
| C++ client | `sigil::protocol::clock::ClockClient` |
| Events sent through | `sigil::protocol::clock::ClockEvents` |
| Python client | sigil.protocol.clock.Clock |

## Commands

### clock.setPolicy

Replaces how the clock moves, from the next frame on.

Answered at once.

Takes `SetPolicyParameters`: What setPolicy is asked.

| Parameter | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `policy` | Policy (enumeration) | Wall | The policy from now on. |
| `budget_seconds` | double, may be absent | absent | Seconds of clock time after which budgetExpired is sent, once; absent for no budget. A budget that runs out with nothing still moving is how a client learns the session settled. |

Answers nothing but that it was done.

### clock.step

Advances the clock by frames or by seconds, drawing each frame, and answers once the last is drawn. Refused unless the policy is Advance.

Answered later, through the reply the agent is handed, once the work is done.

Takes `StepParameters`: What step is asked: frames, or seconds taken as frames of one rate.

| Parameter | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `frames` | uint | 1 | Frames to advance, where seconds is absent. |
| `seconds` | double, may be absent | absent | Seconds to advance, in frames of one over rate; absent to step by frames. |
| `rate` | double | 60.0 | Frames per second the steps are taken at: each frame advances the clock by one over this. |

Answers `StepResult`: Where step left the clock.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `seconds` | double | 0.0 | Clock seconds since the session opened. |
| `frame` | ulong | 0 | Frames drawn since the session opened. |

### clock.current

The clock as it stands.

Answered at once.

Takes nothing.

Answers `CurrentResult`: The clock as it stands.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `policy` | Policy (enumeration) | Wall | The policy it moves by. |
| `seconds` | double | 0.0 | Clock seconds since the session opened. |
| `frame` | ulong | 0 | Frames drawn since the session opened. |
| `paused` | bool | false | Whether pause holds it. |
| `time_scale` | double | 1.0 | Clock seconds per wall second. |
| `budget_remaining` | double, may be absent | absent | Clock seconds of the budget still to run; absent where none was set or it has run out. |

### clock.pause

Holds the clock or lets it go, keeping its policy: the pause a person presses.

Answered at once.

Takes `PauseParameters`: What pause is asked.

| Parameter | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `paused` | bool | true | True to hold the clock where it is, false to let it move again by its policy. |

Answers nothing but that it was done.

### clock.setTimeScale

Sets how many clock seconds pass per wall second.

Answered at once.

Takes `TimeScaleParameters`: What setTimeScale is asked.

| Parameter | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scale` | double | 1.0 | Clock seconds per wall second: one is real time, a half is half speed. The Advance policy steps by its own rate and ignores it. |

Answers nothing but that it was done.

### clock.enable

Starts this client's clock events.

Answered by the dispatcher itself, never by the agent: it starts or stops this client's clock events.

### clock.disable

Stops this client's clock events.

Answered by the dispatcher itself, never by the agent: it starts or stops this client's clock events.

## Events

What the clock tells a client that enabled it.

### clock.budgetExpired

The budget setPolicy set has run out.

Carries `BudgetExpiredEvent`: The budget setPolicy set has run out.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `seconds` | double | 0.0 | Clock seconds when it ran out. |

## Types

### Policy

How a host's clock moves.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `Wall` | The wall clock: a frame advances by the time that passed since the last. What a person watching a window sees. |
| `Advance` | The client's clock: nothing moves except by step, so every frame's time is a function of the steps alone. |
| `Pause` | Frozen: no frame advances, and the recordings a hub plays hold where they are. |
| `PauseWhileLoading` | The wall clock, except that it does not move while a page, a font or a resource the session asked for is still arriving. |
